One-Click Whitening Report

Source: R/whiten_enhancements.R
report_whitening.Rd

Generates a markdown report with model settings and whitening diagnostics.

Usage

report_whitening(
  model,
  data = NULL,
  Z = NULL,
  tune_result = NULL,
  file = "whitening-report.md",
  digits = 4
)

Arguments

model

A whiten_model or whiten_tune object.

data

Optional original-space data matrix used to compute diagnostics.

Z

Optional whitened matrix. If missing and data is provided, predict(model, data) is used.

tune_result

Optional tuning result from auto_tune_whitening().

file

Output markdown path. If NULL, returns report text without writing to disk.

digits

Numeric formatting precision.

Value

If file is non-NULL, invisibly returns the output path. Otherwise returns the markdown text.

See also

whiten_model, auto_tune_whitening

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(200 * 6), 200, 6)
m <- whiten_model(X, method = "ZCA", lambda = 0.1)
txt <- report_whitening(m, data = X, file = NULL)
cat(txt)
#> # Whitening Report
#> 
#> - Generated at: 2026-06-27 21:11:23 UTC
#> - Method: ZCA
#> - Dimensions: 6 -> 6
#> - n_comp: NULL
#> - var_threshold: NULL
#> - explained_var: NA
#> - lambda: 0.1
#> - lambda_input: 0.1
#> - lambda_method: NA
#> - shrink_target: identity
#> - cov_estimator: empirical
#> - sample_weighted: FALSE
#> - eig_method: auto
#> - fast: FALSE
#> - n_obs: 200
#> - update_count: 0
#> 
#> ## Whitening Diagnostics
#> 
#> - diag_mean: 0.9981
#> - diag_min: 0.9757
#> - diag_max: 1.01
#> - offdiag_frob: 0.02447
